name_en: 查士丁尼/拜占庭/法典/圣索菲亚/收复/瘟疫/罗马法/典籍
description_zh: 查士丁尼大帝/拜占庭帝国/罗马法典/圣索菲亚大教堂/瘟疫疫情/领土收复
description_en: Emperor Justinian ruled the Byzantine Empire (527-565 CE), commissioning the Corpus Juris Civilis (Corpus of Civil Law), building the Hagia Sophia, and attempting to reconquer the western Roman territories lost to Germanic invasions. His reign was marked by the devastating Plague of Justinian.
